channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: World's smallest PC with a 16GB GDDR7 desktop RTX 5080 GPU goes on sale for $2,647, but you will have to buy your own SSD, RAM, and OS — Zotac Magnus One Ultra has an 850W PSU and can drive 6 4K monitors
item.description: Zotac fits an RTX 5080 desktop graphics card with 16GB of GDDR7 memory and a 20-core Intel processor into an 11.46-liter chassis, with Japanese prices starting at $2,647.

item.title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
item.description: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.

item.title: The Tesla Roadster is far from the first car to use fans for downforce
item.description: Here are some of the other, older vehicles that use fans for downforce like the Tesla Roadster does.

item.title: TikTok permanently bans ‘Musk’ documentary advertising account
item.description: A four-hour documentary about Elon Musk continues to meet resistance from social media platforms.

item.title: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
item.description: The composition of Anthropic’s workforce and the type of work getting done have changed significantly in the past year.
